verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at a documented openapi.json path. The REST reference overview explicitly frames it as a downloadable spec "to generate clients, run mocks, or feed to AI tools," and per-endpoint Try-it pages back it up. The probe's 404s were at generic root paths, not the documented location, so they do not contradict this. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec at the documented path downloads and parses.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
